title: Attribute-check failures on major one-time emotional beats carry no narrated cost and can be retried immediately (e.g. the first attempt at 'swear the land stays theirs' over the Fallows' two-hundred-body Long Furrow failed with no stated penalty, then succeeded on the very next try), which undercuts the weight the scene is clearly going for.
